🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology). Mixed confirmations: Energy and Tech leadership vs broad sector weakness (9/11 sectors negative) and large-cap divergence (AAPL/MSFT/NVDA ABOVE TREND vs GOOGL/AMZN BELOW TREND); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +15.90%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: RCL (1W: -9.10% | 1M: -17.99%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: +1.55%) CORRECTION. Materials mixed to weak: NEM (1W: -9.26% | 1M: +28.58%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -9.31% | 1M: +13.87%) CORRECTION. Financials soft: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +15.90%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (Tech + Energy + Industrials); Style: Value/Cyclical tilt where energy names lead.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.14% | 1M: +19.49%) CORRECTION, NEM (1W: -9.26% | 1M: +28.58%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -9.31% | 1M: +13.87%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -14.64%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select high-volatility Tech and Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +7.24% | 1M: +15.90%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +11.74%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: ≥3 large names with 1W opposite to 1M (e.g., SHOP, BKNG, NEM, FCX) — treat as tactical noise, watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but supportive (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +5.97%, 24 stocks). Leaders CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, while GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND and AMZN (1W: -2.35% | 1M: -10.25%) BELOW TREND highlight internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak on the week (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%, 20 stocks). Selects: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION; overall sector under pressure and earnings/transaction headlines could drive dispersion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare soft on the week but positive over 1M (1W: -1.62% | 1M: +4.86%, 17 stocks). Mixed names: JNJ (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +7.12%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -4.59%) BELOW TREND; monitor news-driven catalysts in MDT/MRK/AMGN.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy leaders and select Tech winners (CRM, MPC, SLB) and reduce exposure to the most stretched or structurally weak names in Consumer Discretionary and select Financials (PYPL, SHOP). Style: mixed with a Value/Cyclical tilt; monitor major divergences before committing to broader shifts.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.52% | 1M: +25.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND — watch guidance follow-through. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -11.92%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND — watch earnings/positioning risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +13.22%) — clear leader on the week. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.87%) and Industrials (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -3.78%) — watch guidance and order flow for downside risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) — confirm revenue acceleration on next print. NVDA (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND — watch earnings cadence and AI demand comments for catch-up. PYPL (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND — monitor follow-up M&A/strategic headlines for further downside. XOM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +6.81%) ABOVE TREND — sustainment above 1M trend validates energy leadership.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CRM (+75): Raised guidance and heavy bullish news; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) — sentiment confirmed. NVDA (+60): Positive headlines and strong earnings narrative; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +5.23%) — confirming accumulation. GOOGL (+60): Positive PR around Berkshire stake but price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.44% | 1M: -10.30%) — sentiment/pricing diverge, watch for distribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-60): Critical headlines and operational scrutiny; price BELOW TREND (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -11.92%) — bearish confirmed. PYPL (-50): Deal fallout headlines and weak price action; price BELOW TREND (1W: -15.85% | 1M: -9.45%) — sentiment confirmed. ORCL (-50): Negative analyst action flagged; price not in detailed view for cross-check, monitor for follow-through.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed with a Value/Cyclical tilt. CRM (1W: +25.48% | 1M: +38.81%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names MPC (1W: +7.92% | 1M: +25.09%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is the large-cap divergence and news/price disconnects (GOOGL, AMZN, PYPL) that could keep breadth constrained.
